scope: At most two lightweight continuation batches against the exact production pending queue; protected snapshots excluded.

frozen_queue.predicate: falsification_status in {unresolved,deferred} and no persisted falsification iterations

stop_conditions: Any production pending-queue or repository digest changes.
Any provider attempt lacks authoritative usage metadata.
Either batch fails or any aggregate/per-batch ceiling is exhausted.
The lightweight pending queue reaches zero.

claim_boundary.prior_authorizations: All prior attempts and costs remain separately accounted and are not reauthorized.
claim_boundary.connectivity: A clean tranche is bounded operational evidence, not proof of general provider reliability.
claim_boundary.protected_pair: Neither protected serialize-javascript snapshot is authorized.
